correctness.rationale: Unique mixed-face center is proved using triangle-freeness; descending-cardinality pairs are genuine free-face/cofacet collapses. The target connects two closed-neighborhood complexes through a simplex, yielding homotopy wedge. Bridge and cycle blocks are calculated integrally; Mayer–Vietoris makes the flag inclusion kernel the primitive span of exactly square cycles. The companion verifier checked 384 free collapses and ten independent mod-101 finite homology cases; finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proofs.
